aparte.description: A quick side question: answered with the conversation as context, and not kept
aparte.usage: Usage: /btw <question> (answered on the side; not kept in the conversation)
aparte.no_llm: Side questions need the LLM, and it isn't configured.

custo.description: Shows (on) or hides (off) the tokens and US$ under each answer
custo.on: 💲 From now on each answer shows its tokens and cost (this session). /usage off hides it.
custo.state_on: The cost footer is on. /usage off hides it.
custo.state_off: The cost footer is off. /usage on shows tokens and US$ under each answer.
custo.no_stm: The cost footer needs the short-term memory (Redis).

doctor.description: Checks the setup (.env, services, index, sizes, MCP, disk) and says how to fix problems
doctor.title: 🩺 Setup check

ok.env: .env matches .env.example ({missing} optional settings left at their defaults)
ok.index: search index: {indexed} notes, the vault has {notes}

problem.env_unknown: .env has settings .env.example doesn't know: {keys}. Fix: check the names (a typo means the default is used).
problem.env_missing: no .env or .env.example in the repository. Fix: copy .env.example to .env and fill it in.
problem.service: {name} is down. Fix: docker compose up -d (and docker compose logs for the reason).
problem.index: search index has {indexed} notes but the vault has {notes}. Fix: /reindex.
problem.index_error: the search index could not be read ({error}). Fix: /reindex.
problem.vectors: hybrid search is on but its table can't be read ({error}). Fix: /reindex.
problem.size: {name} is over its limit ({chars}/{limit}). Fix: /profile consolidate (or trim it by hand).
problem.mcp_config: data/mcp.json has an error: {error}. Fix: correct it and /mcp reload.
problem.mcp_down: the MCP gateway doesn't answer ({error}). Fix: docker compose up -d mcp.
problem.disk: disk ({name}) is almost full: {free} GB free, {used}% used. Fix: free some space (docker system prune, old backups).
